[Article 4] How to calculate interest on Savings accounts
## Interest accrual and multiple Savings accounts
Interest accrues daily, but if it's less than 0.01 EUR/GBP/USD, it won't be paid until the cumulative interest exceeds this amount. Interest accrues on a single deposit per Savings account product for every partner bank. You can create multiple Savings accounts in-app for each partner bank product.
If you hold a GBP Savings account with our partner, Clearbank, each of these multiple Savings accounts corresponds to a single Savings account with Clearbank. This means that interest is paid individually on each of the accounts.
Our other partners, though, view your separate Savings accounts in the Revolut app as a single deposit. This means that interest is paid on the total balance in a single payment. When we receive it, we distribute it across your accounts based on their balances when the interest was calculated.

## Here's an interest accrual example
Consider a balance of £1,000 with a 2.5% annual interest rate, compounded daily:

## Day 2
- Interest accrued: £1,000 * 2.50%/365 = £0.0684932
- Interest paid: £0.06 (remaining amount keeps accruing until it becomes £0.01)
- New balance: £1,000 + £0.06 = £1,000.06

## Day 3
- Interest accrued: £1,000.06 * 2.50%/365 = £0.0684973
- Interest paid: £0.06 + £0.01 = £0.07 (accrued interest of Day 1: £0.0084932 and Day 2: £0.0084973)
- New balance: £1,000.06 + £0.07 = £1,000.13

## Interest accrual and multiple Savings accounts
Interest accrues daily, but if it's less than 0.01 EUR/GBP/USD, it won't be paid until the cumulative interest exceeds this amount. Interest accrues on a single deposit per Savings account product for every partner bank. You can create multiple Savings accounts in-app for each partner bank product.

Consider a balance of £1,000 with a 2.5% annual interest rate, compounded daily:

## Day 2
- Interest accrued: £1,000 * 2.50%/365 = £0.0684932

- the merchant is experiencing a technical disruption
- the merchant declined the transaction because of regional restrictions or security controls on their side

A PIN code is a 4-digit number used to authorise transactions at ATMs and payment terminals. If needed, you can change your PIN at any ATM with the 'PIN services' feature. Remember, your 4-digit card PIN is different from your Revolut app's 6-digit passcode.

- Go to 'Home' on the bottom menu
- Tap the cards icon in the top right corner
- Select the card you need to unblock
- Tap 'Settings'

Make sure the contactless feature is enabled for your card in-app:
- Go to 'Home' on the bottom menu
- Tap the cards icon in the top-right corner
- Select the card and tap 'Settings'
- Scroll down and enable the 'Contactless payments' toggle
If the feature is enabled and the issue persists, check if the problem is being caused on the merchant’s side by trying to pay using another payment terminal.

## My card isn't working for chip and PIN payments
The reason why your card isn’t working should be visible in your transactions listhttps://app.revolut.com/transactionsrevolut://app/transaction-list. Some other reasons could be:
- PIN tries exceeded
- Card blocked due to location-based security
- Spending limit reached
If your card isn't working for ATM withdrawals, the issue may be with the ATM itself and possibly due to temporary or connectivity problems. You can try using a different machine by checking nearby ATMs with our in-app ATM locator.

---

[Article 2] My single-use virtual card isn't working
Single-use virtual cards are designed for one-time online transactions. Your single-use card will automatically generate new card details after one use, or after 24 hours.

## Your single-use virtual card won’t work if:
- The card is used for recurring card payments, subscriptions, or deposits (e.g. car rentals, hotels)
- We suspect the merchant will charge your card again
- You try to withdraw cash with the disposable virtual card
- The terminal asks for a PIN
- You try to add it to Apple Pay or Google Pay
Single-use virtual cards are automatically terminated after making a payment. You can still receive refunds to your Revolut account even if the single-use card number is no longer active.

## Card details verification
To protect your card details, we may ask you to confirm your login information to view your single-use virtual card details. We’ll either send you an authentication code via SMS or email, or ask you to confirm your information with Face ID or Touch ID. 
To switch to a different verification method, simply tap 'Choose another method'.

---

[Article 3] My virtual card is not working
If you're trying to use your virtual card, and it's not working, you may be trying to carry out an action that virtual cards don't support. See below for more details.

## What you can't do with a virtual card
- Pay at terminals that ask for a PIN
- Pay via contactless above the allowed limit, usually £50 or equivalent
- Withdraw cash
- You can't create  more than 4 cards per month

## What you can't do with a single-use virtual card
- Set up recurring card payments, subscriptions, or deposits (e.g. car rentals, hotels)
- Pay if we suspect the merchant will charge you again
- Withdraw cash
- Pay at any terminal that asks for a PIN
- Add it to Apple Pay or Google Pay
Single-use virtual cards are designed for one-time online transactions. Your single-use card will automatically generate new card details after one use, or after 24 hours. Single-use virtual cards are automatically terminated after making a payment.
You can still receive refunds to your Revolut account even if the single-use virtual card number or regular virtual card  is no longer active.

---

## Reset your card's contactless limit
You may have reached the contactless limit for a certain card. To reset it in the Revolut app:
- Go to 'Home' on the bottom menu
- Tap the cards iconhttps://app.revolut.com/cards/overviewrevolut://app/cards in the top-right corner
- Select your card
- Tap 'Settings'
- Scroll down and make sure 'Contactless payments' are enabled
- If the 'Contactless limit' is reached, tap 'Reset'

## If resetting the limit doesn’t work
- Check if the card is activated: select the card in the cards section and tap 'Activate now', choose 'I have my card', or make a PIN purchase and then attempt the payment again
- If you used Apple Pay or Google Pay: re-add the card to your wallet or create a new virtual card, then retry the payment
- Check for card damage: if the physical card is damaged or worn out, it may not work. You can order a replacement by selecting the damaged card in the cards sectionhttps://app.revolut.com/cards/overviewrevolut://app/cards and tapping 'Replace card'

## Receiving bank transfers to your Joint account
To receive a bank transfer to your Joint account, you'll need to give the sender your Joint account details. To view your details:

- Below your balance, tap 'Accounts'

- Tap 'More' and 'Details'

- Go to 'Home' on the bottom menu
- Below your balance, tap Accounts
- Select your Joint account
- Tap 'Move' and proceed

- Go to 'Home' on the bottom menu
- Below your balance, tap Accounts

Currency exchanges can’t be cancelled once completed. You can only revert them by making a new exchange (exchanging the money back into your base currency). Given exchange rates are variable, you may not end up with the full amount back.

[Article 3] Setting up a Joint account
A Joint account is a shared account between two Revolut customers. It’s not just for partners and spouses — friends, family, and housemates can open an account to simplify expense sharing. Both account holders can add, withdraw, manage, and spend money in the Joint account.
Read our Joint Accounts T&Cshttps://www.revolut.com/legal/joint-accounts/?geo-redirect=true to learn more.
To apply for a Joint account (or manage your current Joint account), use this link.

## Requirements for opening a Joint account
- Be at least 18 years old
- Have a personal Revolut account and have passed our identity verification checks
- Live in the same country as the person you’re opening the account with
- Both Joint account owners must belong to the same Revolut entity. For example, Revolut Bank UAB. To check your Revolut entity, tap your profile icon in the top left corner and scroll to the bottom of the page
- Not have another Revolut Joint account, or a pending invite for one
- Already have the person you want to open the account with in your contacts. If not, send a small amount of money to their Revolut account to make them a contact before you try to open a Joint account together. To read more about sending money to other Revolut customers, read this FAQ/help/transfers/internal-transfers/send-or-request-money-from-other-revolut-customers

- Go to 'Home' on the bottom menu
- Below your balance, tap 'Accounts' and 'Add new'
- Select 'Joint' and follow the instructions
The other applicant needs to accept your invitation.

## Paid plans and Joint accounts
- Each account holder has their own usage limits based on their individual Revolut plan
- Joint account fees are deducted from the joint account only
- Insurance benefits don't apply to Joint account activity
- Savings accounts can't be opened on Joint accounts
If one of the Joint account holders has a Metal or Ultra plan, any eligible card payments made with your Joint account card will earn RevPoints. Learn more about RevPoints from these FAQs in our Help Centre.

---

[Article 4] I want to close my Joint account
You can close a Joint account directly in-app, but first, you need to bring the account balance to zero. Either of the Joint account holders can withdraw money without needing the other's consent.

## How to close the Joint account
In the Revolut app:
- Go to 'Home' on the bottom menu
- Below your balance, tap Accounts
- Select your Joint account
- Tap 'Details'
- Scroll down and select 'Close Joint account'
Once you close the Joint account, we'll deactivate any cards linked to the Joint account. We'll also send ‌both co-holders their Joint account statements by email.

[Article 2] How to calculate interest on Savings accounts
## Interest accrual and multiple Savings accounts
Interest accrues daily, but if it's less than 0.01 EUR/GBP/USD, it won't be paid until the cumulative interest exceeds this amount. Interest accrues on a single deposit per Savings account product for every partner bank. You can create multiple Savings accounts in-app for each partner bank product.
If you hold a GBP Savings account with our partner, Clearbank, each of these multiple Savings accounts corresponds to a single Savings account with Clearbank. This means that interest is paid individually on each of the accounts.
Our other partners, though, view your separate Savings accounts in the Revolut app as a single deposit. This means that interest is paid on the total balance in a single payment. When we receive it, we distribute it across your accounts based on their balances when the interest was calculated.

## Here's an interest accrual example
Consider a balance of £1,000 with a 2.5% annual interest rate, compounded daily:

## Day 2
- Interest accrued: £1,000 * 2.50%/365 = £0.0684932
- Interest paid: £0.06 (remaining amount keeps accruing until it becomes £0.01)
- New balance: £1,000 + £0.06 = £1,000.06

## Day 3
- Interest accrued: £1,000.06 * 2.50%/365 = £0.0684973
- Interest paid: £0.06 + £0.01 = £0.07 (accrued interest of Day 1: £0.0084932 and Day 2: £0.0084973)
- New balance: £1,000.06 + £0.07 = £1,000.13

The interest rate on your Savings account depends on your plan. If you change your plan, your rate will change accordingly when the plan change comes into effect. The Annual Equivalent Rate (AER) shows the amount of interest you'd earn in a year, taking into account daily compounding. This allows you to compare rates with a different compounding schedule.
You can see the AER under your savings account balance in-app by tapping 'Info' and viewing the 'Deposit Information' or 'Summary Box' document.

We always negotiate the best possible rates for our customers. However, our bank partners offer their own competitive rates, which may differ. Customers are able to choose the best rates — see this article — while keeping other factors such as maximum deposit amounts in mind. See this FAQhttps://help.revolut.com/help/app-features/savings-vaults/getting-started-with-instant-access-savings/ for more.

## How is the interest calculated and paid?
Interest is accrued and paid daily. While interest accrues daily, the minimum threshold for interest payable is GBP 0.01; this means interest may not be paid to your savings every day (until net interest becomes at least GBP 0.01). This is the only case where the interest payout would be postponed.
Funds must arrive at the partner bank before starting to earn interest. Funds usually arrive on the next business day after sending.
For example, a deposit made on Friday settles by Monday, and interest begins to accrue from Tuesday. For GBP savings with Clearbank, your funds settle immediately in most cases and start accruing interest from the next calendar day.

[Article 4] How is interest calculated on tiered Instant Access Savings?
## Savings in local currency
A tiered rate model follows the below structure:
- Balances up to £200,000 earn the regular plan rate
- Balances over £200,000 and up to £5,000,000 will earn a lowered rate — only for customers on eligible plans. Eligible plans: Ultra
- Balances on other plans continue to earn the regular plan rate on their full balance up to £5,000,000
A blended rate is calculated using the 2 rates, and the resulting rate is applied to your Instant Access Savings balance (across all personal Instant Access Savings balance in the same local currency).

## Example for Ultra plan in GBP
If you have £300,000 saved across all your personal Instant Access Savings balance (in the same local currency):
- £200,000 earns 4.00% AER — tier 1
- £100,000 earns 3.51% AER — tier 2
- 3.92% (expressed as AER) is the blended rate applied to the full balance

## Blended rate calculation (for above example)
- Step 1: Multiply the amount below and above the £200,000 threshold by their respective per annum (p.a.) rates, then add the results. Divide this total by the full balance to get the blended rate in p.a.: (£200,000 times 3.93% p.a. + £100,000 times 3.69% p.a.) ÷ £300,000 = 3.85% p.a
- Step 2: Convert to AER to reflect compounding
This blended rate of 3.92% AER is applied to the full balance.

## Savings in non-local currencies
If you hold deposits in either or both USD and EUR with Investec, the total (across both currencies) must not exceed the £120,000 equivalent.

## Interest accrual and multiple Savings accounts
Interest accrues daily, but if it's less than 0.01 EUR/GBP/USD, it won't be paid until the cumulative interest exceeds this amount. Interest accrues on a single deposit per Savings account product for every partner bank. You can create multiple Savings accounts in-app for each partner bank product.

- Interest paid: £0.06 + £0.01 = £0.07 (accrued interest of Day 1: £0.0084932 and Day 2: £0.0084973)

- Balances on other plans continue to earn the regular plan rate on their full balance up to £5,000,000

- 3.92% (expressed as AER) is the blended rate applied to the full balance

- Step 2: Convert to AER to reflect compounding

If you hold deposits in either or both USD and EUR with Investec, the total (across both currencies) must not exceed the £120,000 equivalent.

## What is Kids & Teens Save?
Revolut Kids & Teens Save introduces children and teens to saving with Pockets, a feature allowing parents or guardians, and their child to create and customise savings compartments. Money can be added by either party. Funds from a closed Pocket will be returned to the child's main account balance.

They might claim they have an overdue bill that must be paid within the hour, or that they are stranded and need money for emergency travel. They rely on you acting out of panic rather than logic. They will ask you to transfer funds to a friend's account that actually belongs to a fraudster.
